waterRiskCheck.description: Get information and recommendations for your address
waterRiskCheck.title: Water risk check
waterRiskCheck.generelExplenationText: The flood prevention guide provides you with recommendations on the individual risk situation and suggested measures for your property. The guide combines our specialist knowledge, water maps and your answers in a short questionnaire to create a customized recommendation. This document also tells you what to do in an emergency. The guide begins by entering your address in the search field on the left-hand side. The specific entry enables a more precise evaluation of the specialist cards. The short questionnaire then starts with four questions.
waterRiskCheck.informationText: The questionnaire is aimed exclusively at authorized users. You are authorized if you live at the address entered or are the owner of the property in question. With "Start questionnaire" you confirm that you are authorized for the requested address.
